Programmatic management of object specifications (object_spec).

This command group provides operations for spec management:
  list   - List available object specifications (from storage or bundled)
  get    - Get specification details for an object kind
  fields - Inspect fields and validation rules for an object kind

Flags:
    --ignore-scheduler-down
      Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown

  List specs
  zqk spec list
  List specs as JSON
  zqk spec list --format json
  Get spec details
  zqk spec get backlog_item
  Inspect spec fields
  zqk spec fields backlog_item

Usage:
  zqk object spec [command]

Available Commands:
  fields      Inspect field schema and validation rules for an object kind
  get         Get object specification details
  list        List available object specifications

Flags:
      --columns string          Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
  -f, --format string           Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link, raw, md, html) (default "table")
      --ignore-scheduler-down   Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
  -o, --output string           Write output to file
  -q, --quiet                   Suppress non-essential output
      --timeout duration        Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose                 Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
      --internal         Elevated access mode for built-in and internal kinds (requires Enterprise license or zqk-admin)

Use "zqk object spec [command] --help" for more information about a command.
